open_points.subject: check_request_id_form
open_points.text: MUST answer a FailedValue with the MISSING_VALUE member of = models.RefusalKind when request_id is None, empty or made only of code points of the imported WHITE_SPACE_CODE_POINTS constant
open_points.other_text: and one with the MALFORMED_REQUEST_ID member when it holds a control, format, surrogate, private-use or unassigned code point of Unicode's general categories
open_points.question: Which refusal must be returned for a request_id made only of control characters that belong to WHITE_SPACE_CODE_POINTS, such as tabs or line breaks: MISSING_VALUE or MALFORMED_REQUEST_ID?

open_points.subject: check_request_id_form note
open_points.text: a control, format, surrogate, private-use or unassigned code point of Unicode's general categories
open_points.rule: Inline-данные: таблицы соответствий, allow-lists, пороги, TTL, пути, рейтинги, размеры, словари alias'ов.
open_points.question: The closed subset of Unicode general categories must become an imported policy constant, and the note must name that imported constant.

open_points.subject: check_value_forms note
open_points.text: a floor area that is not a decimal number, written as text of one or more ASCII digits, the first not the digit zero unless it is the only digit before the full stop or the end, optionally followed by a full stop and one or more ASCII digits, with no sign and no exponent, or is not greater than the imported OBJECT_FLOOR_AREA_MIN_EXCLUSIVE constant, a number of rooms that is not a whole number, written as text of an optional hyphen-minus and one or more ASCII digits, the first digit not the digit zero unless it is the only one and no hyphen-minus before a lone zero, or is less than the imported OBJECT_ROOMS_MIN constant, or a floor that is not a whole number so written; no other text is a number, a decimal comma, a plus sign, white space and a leading zero included
open_points.rule:
Нота остаётся требованием к
поведению: выражения, вызовы методов, точечная навигация и строковый
микро-синтаксис в ней запрещены.
open_points.question: The inline textual-number micro-syntax must be moved into an imported policy symbol or an explicit parsing contract, and the note must refer to that symbol or contract instead of spelling out the grammar.

open_points.subject: check_value_forms test-evidence note
open_points.text: a number of rooms equal to the imported OBJECT_ROOMS_MIN constant passes while one below it and one with a fraction each answer OUTSIDE_FORM; a floor area equal to the imported OBJECT_FLOOR_AREA_MIN_EXCLUSIVE constant or below it answers OUTSIDE_FORM and the smallest positive decimal written passes as given; a negative whole floor passes and a floor with a fraction answers OUTSIDE_FORM; an object kind outside = models.ObjectKind and a customer language outside = models.CustomerLanguage answer OUTSIDE_CLOSED_LIST; several values outside their form are all answered together, each with its path.
open_points.rule:
**Член перечисления** note называет его именем рядом с адресом перечисления:
`the EXPENSE_CREATE member of = models.AuditAction`.
open_points.question: Each OUTSIDE_FORM and OUTSIDE_CLOSED_LIST reference must name the member together with its enum address, for example `the OUTSIDE_FORM member of = models.RefusalKind`.
